name: Crater
description: Verbatim port of Akaunting's updater: Guzzle verify=>false, extracts a ZIP over the live app with no hash/signature. [Opus-verified: CONFIRMED-D]
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Crater’s admin updater uses Guzzle verify=false, downloads the archive, extracts it over the Laravel root, and has no package signature/hash.
limitations: Source review is limited to the retained commit and does not establish released-artifact or current-upstream behavior.

original_evidence.text: | Crater | https://github.com/crater-invoice/crater | 05d5ce26 / 2023-02-19 (stale, last commit 2023) | Y | N (admin-triggered via UI: download → unzip → copyFiles → migrate, each a separate authorized HTTP endpoint) | Y | https, **TLS validation explicitly DISABLED** | N | none | server-supplied, unpinned | `app/Space/SiteApi.php:14` `$client = new Client(['verify' => false, 'base_uri' => config('crater.base_url').'/']);` (Guzzle `verify=>false` disables cert validation); `config/crater.php:49` `'base_url' => 'https://craterapp.com'`; download+extract-over-app in `app/Space/Updater.php` (`download()` writes zip via `getRemote()`, `unzip()` extracts with `ZipArchive`, `copyFiles()` does `File::copyDirectory($temp_extract_dir.'/Crater', base_path())` — no hash/signature check anywhere in `Updater.php`); admin gating via `authorize('manage update app')` in `app/Http/Controllers/V1/Admin/Update/UpdateController.php` |
